gen-gf-noto-serif-todhri-fs-epilogue: Epilogue is curvy and loose, with a tall-bodied lowercase and wiry, pressure-free lines. Noto Serif Todhri brings the pair's strongest quality: a refined, traditional heading whose small letters nearly match its capitals.
gen-gf-noto-serif-todhri-fs-fira-sans: Noto Serif Todhri's small letters rise almost to capital height, and its thin strokes carry about half the weight of its thick ones. Fira Sans stays smooth and generous below.
gen-gf-noto-serif-todhri-fs-public-sans: Noto Serif Todhri sets a traditional tone with tightening at its curve tops. Public Sans does the opposite job, offering a hefty, sturdy lowercase with broad counters that hold up text.
gen-gf-noto-serif-todhri-fs-supreme: Tiny lowercase letters that nearly reach capital height give Noto Serif Todhri its character, with heavy stems easing into lighter curves. Supreme adds a dense, crisp band of text, its letters held open rather than curled shut.
gen-gf-noto-serif-todhri-general-sans: General Sans fills the line with a tall x-height and smooth curves drawn at steady pressure. Beside Noto Serif Todhri's subtle, etched-glass weight changes, the text feels crisp and unhurried.
gen-gf-noto-serif-todhri-manrope: Manrope keeps a bright gap at each curved letter's mouth and holds its line to one width. And Noto Serif Todhri, with bowls that thin slightly at the sides, gives that plainness a traditional counterpoint.
gen-gf-noto-serif-todhri-montserrat: Wide, gliding, wire-fine lines meet worn-stamp texture here. Noto Serif Todhri excels at restrained thick-thin play in its headings, and Montserrat handles the body with oversized e and a counters and no shading at all.
gen-gf-noto-serif-todhri-satoshi: Noto Serif Todhri sits between monoline and razor-thin hairlines. Satoshi's soaring x-height and wide-open e, with every stroke cut to a single width, make the pair's strongest quality its quiet, wiry contrast.
gen-gf-noto-serif-todhri-switzer: Switzer draws tubular, wire-like letters with a tall waist line and c tips that never creep toward touching. Beside Noto Serif Todhri's worn-stamp thick-thin play, the contrast of stroke is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-noto-serif-todhri-work-sans: Noto Serif Todhri's curves keep real weight even at their thinnest points, giving its small letters a sturdy refinement. And Work Sans matches that firmness with a high mean line and joins that never taper.
